item_short_desc: Rothco’s Waterproof Map & Document Case is the ultimate solution for safeguarding your essential guides, maps, documents, and other critical paperwork while navigating the great outdoors. Constructed from durable waterproof material, this protective case features a re-sealable closure and heat-pressed seals, ensuring your documents stay dry and protected from water and outdoor debris. The transparent window allows you to mark your location, destination, and other essential information using dry-erase markers.
description: Rothco’s Waterproof Map & Document Case is the ultimate solution for safeguarding your essential guides, maps, documents, and other critical paperwork while navigating the great outdoors. Constructed from durable waterproof material, this protective case features a re-sealable closure and heat-pressed seals, ensuring your documents stay dry and protected from water and outdoor debris. The transparent window allows you to mark your location, destination, and other essential information using dry-erase markers without writing directly on your map. With 14.75 inch x 12.5 inch of usable space, this lightweight plastic case offers ample room for your important papers and can also be used to store other survival supplies, such as first-aid gear or small electronics. The case’s versatile design allows it to be folded, rolled up, or attached to other outdoor gear using the corner carabiner clips, making it easy to store and travel with. Ideal for campers, travelers, sailors, and outdoor enthusiasts who need reliable protection for their documents.
